tagline: Premium car rental leader delivering exceptional customer experiences
hero_kpi_rationale: Continuous revenue growth reaching 4.0 billion EUR in 2024, marking the third consecutive year of records, reflecting the robustness of the business model in the face of macroeconomic challenges.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned by the company through its car rental activities and associated services.
kpis.description: Revenue reached a new historical peak in 2024, driven by strong demand across all geographic segments.
kpis.signal: Third consecutive year of record revenues.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Operating profit before depreciation and amortization, measuring operational performance.
kpis.description: EBITDA advanced significantly to 1.46 billion EUR (vs. 0.65 billion EUR in 2023), driven by improved fleet rotation and reinforced cost discipline.
kpis.signal: New EBITDA record despite challenging conditions.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by revenue, indicating operational profitability.
kpis.description: Operating margin declined to 8.4% (vs. 12.8% in 2023) due to increased depreciation and residual value losses, particularly in the first half.
kpis.signal: Decline linked to vehicle residual value losses.

kpis.name: Total headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working in the company (annual average).
kpis.description: Headcount reached 8,923 employees on average, up 2.1%, to support network growth and service expansion.
kpis.signal: Moderate headcount growth to support expansion.

kpis.name: Average fleet size
kpis.explanation: Average number of rental vehicles available on the market during the year.
kpis.description: Average fleet grew to 357,100 vehicles, up 15.8%, supported by increased rotation and new purchases at better terms.
kpis.signal: Significant fleet expansion to meet demand.

kpis.name: Share of premium vehicles
kpis.explanation: Proportion of premium vehicles added to the fleet in terms of value.
kpis.description: Premium vehicle share declined to 49%, after remaining stable around 57% since 2021, reflecting portfolio rebalancing.
kpis.signal: Reduction in premium mix after several stable years.

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.explanation: Amount paid to shareholders per ordinary share.
kpis.description: Proposed dividend is 2.70 EUR per ordinary share, down 30.8%, but the payout ratio remains elevated at 52.1%.
kpis.signal: Dividend reduction after several years of strong distributions.

risks.title: Dependence on used vehicle residual prices
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly mentioned in Item 1A (SIXT SHARE section) as key 2024 underperformance factor. Direct language: 'declining used car prices...had a negative impact on the residual values of vehicle fleets and thus reduced earnings'. Impact materialized in results. Trend: persistent issue affecting sector profitability.

risks.title: Geographic expansion and North American market integration
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned as major strategic focus by Supervisory Board ('focus was on the North American market and its unique features'). Ambitious objective achieved: 50 major airports. Language indicating regulatory and operational complexity specific to the region. Risk of failure to achieve growth objectives.

risks.title: Transition to electric fleet electrification
risks.score_rationale: Identified as Supervisory Board focus item ('status of the electrification of the SIXT fleet'). Neutral language but indicating active monitoring. Technology and capital investment risk linked to uncertain e-mobility demand explicitly mentioned.

risks.title: Intense competition in the car rental sector
risks.score_rationale: Implicit context: 'very challenging market environment for car rental companies' mentioned in Supervisory Board remarks. Performance comparison to competitors: 'compared to listed competitors, both share classes developed much more stable' suggests relative volatility. Structural sector risk affecting valuation.

risks.title: Dependence on digital platform and SIXT app ecosystem
risks.score_rationale: Core strategy explicitly described: 'end-to-end digitalisation...via the SIXT app' and '70% of reservations via online and mobile channels'. Risk of technology disruption, cybersecurity implicit, dependence on customer adoption. Language indicating critical strategic importance.

risks.title: Regulatory and CSRD/sustainability compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in Audit Committee: 'informed several times about the state of preparation of sustainability reporting in accordance with the CSRD'. Language indicating ongoing work and growing regulatory complexity. Risk of non-compliance with new European requirements.

risks.title: Results volatility and dependence on macroeconomic conditions
risks.score_rationale: Supervisory Board discussed 'continuing overall macroeconomic challenges' and 'economic and strategic assumptions underlying this planning'. Stock price down 22.1% in 2024 despite record revenues. Language indicating high macro sensitivity.

risks.title: Risks related to management changes and continuity
risks.score_rationale: Two management transitions in 2024: CEO James Adams departure in February and CFO replacement in June. Neutral language ('by mutual agreement') but indicating managerial transitions. Moderate risk to strategic continuity mitigated by planned succession.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or AI initiatives in the 2024 annual report. Technology investments are described in general terms, without reference to specific AI tools or platforms. Efforts focus on customer experience optimization and operational efficiency.
evidence: Investments in tech and innovation are not an end in themselves
no mention of AI, machine learning, or generative AI
focus on customer journey and efficiency improvements via apps and digital channels
